messages:
noah: hey everyone, excited to start! quick inventory question: monitor arrived but there were no VESA screws in the box so i can't mount it on the arm. also the included USB-Ethernet adapter is USB-C but my dongle hub is USB-A only. who should i bug for small parts?
ellie_it: welcome Noah :wave: sorry about that. we usually include both screw kits but sometimes they miss. we can drop a VESA screw pack and a USB-A ethernet dongle to your desk. can you share your desk number and monitor model?
noah: desk 7B-2. monitor is Acer ProView 24 (serial APV-3349). thanks!
shipping-bot: package PKG-9215 delivered to 7th floor bench 2 at 08:50. items: MacBook Air, Acer ProView 24, USB-C dock. missing: VESA screws, USB-A ethernet dongle.
ellie_it: thanks. i'll create an IT ticket and mark it high priority since it's a new hire. also quick note: if you're planning to use the laptop in open seating, do you want a privacy screen? we have 13/14" and 16" sizes.
noah: yes please 14" privacy screen would be great.
ellie_it: got it. creating ticket now. it-bot: ticket IT-7103 created and assigned to ellie_it. ETA delivery 4 hours.
noah: one more thing: i'm trying to join corpwifi but after i enter SSO it says ‘Device not recognized’. followed onboarding doc for VPN and MDM enrollment but still no network. anyone seen that?
ellie_it: that error usually means device fingerprinting failed in our endpoint security see-if. did you enroll the device under your employee email? open https://mdm.redwood.example/device and check status.
noah: shows 'pending profile installation'. i clicked retry but it times out.
ellie_it: can you run `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output? also try rebooting once after retrying enroll.
noah: output: "No enrollment profiles installed". rebooted once, retried -> still pending.
ellie_it: i triggered a re-sync for your device id D-7788 and pushed the enrollment again. it-bot: MDM re-enrollment queued for noah@redwood.com (device id D-7788). expected completion 10m.
sam: tagging onto this thread 1: if MDM is pending it can block network cert install which causes corpwifi fingerprint to fail. if the MDM push doesn't finish i'll swing by with a temporary ethernet dongle so you can finish bootstrap.
noah: appreciate it. thanks for the fast turnaround.
ellie_it: MDM completed and profile installed. try rejoining corpwifi and restart the VPN client after you connect.
noah: ok rejoined corpwifi successfully and vpn connected fine. thanks! also saw the shipping note that parts are en route.
noah: update ~3hrs later: VESA screw pack and USB-A ethernet dongle dropped off at desk, privacy screen included. everything mounted and working. thanks team :tada:
ellie_it: awesome, glad it's sorted. closing ticket IT-7103 unless you need anything else. ping here if anything pops up.
